row.notes: myteam-g1: Handles click event 0x106149d3 on a driver in the My Team contracts screen: reads the comp at screen+0x2d90 (DriverContractsMyTeamComponent); if the slot is already state 3 or no talk days remain it plays my_team_driver_contracts_wont_negotiate feedback, else calls FUN_140db66b0(comp, driver, state 2 or 3) to start early talks (my_team_driver_contracts_in_early_talks) and raises calendar event 0x22.

verify.notes: V10108 Strings/callees/offsets in the decompile match the claimed role.
